title: Mapping
text: Maps that draw themselves as you explore, routes and places you plan together, and scenes that move as one piece.

title: Drawing
text: Sketching for everyone at once, with shapes and stamps, and walls and doors added with a single click.

title: Calls and streaming
text: Voice and video for a group, a camera that follows the action, and streams that set themselves up.

title: Collaboration
text: Chat, polls, budgets and calendars that keep a whole group on the same page.

title: Interfaces and tools
text: Windows, toolbars, menus, dialogs and chat cards that plug into one shared shell.

title: APIs and infrastructure
text: A documented public API, shared hooks and sockets that let a suite of tools work as one, and a collaboration server behind it all.

title: Design systems
text: Token-based themes with light and dark sets, documented components and patterns, ready for other tools to use.

title: Architecture and documentation
text: Clear ownership boundaries, written architecture, and a documentation standard that every module follows.

title: Data and content
text: Searchable codexes, image caches, imports and exports, and settings you can back up and restore.

title: Automation
text: Rules that start the right sound, scene or recording the moment something happens.

title: Rules and systems
text: Combat cards, injuries, shops and crafting that follow the rules without slowing anyone down.

title: Trust and permissions
text: Server-enforced roles, guests who join with just a name, and GM-approved actions for things a player cannot do alone.
